title: Graduate in Cap and Gown, Holding Diploma - Vintage 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A full-length snapshot of a young man wearing traditional academic regalia—a black graduation gown and mortarboard cap with a tassel—looking down at an opened diploma folder. Taken in bright sunlight on a herringbone brick entryway alongside a louvered door and small garden patch. The border is machine-stamped 'NOV 57' with deckled edges, reflecting mid-century American graduation traditions during the postwar educational boom.
